descriptor.retrieval_description: The object is a small, smooth, white plastic charging case with rounded vertical lateral surfaces suitable for parallel jaw grasping across its opposing sides.
descriptor.contact_region: The opposing lateral vertical flanks of the case, located between the front and back faces.
descriptor.visible_surface_condition: Smooth, clean, and reflective with a horizontal seam line near the upper section.
descriptor.local_geometry: Slightly convex vertical side surfaces with rounded corner transitions and a horizontal parting line encircling the upper portion.
